patterns.pattern: ^，只有 ([\d,]+) 条形成已验证通过记录。缺失验收的记录显示为未测，不进入任务通过率分母或失败数；不能据此宣称参评产品不支持文件下载。后续调用通过统一文件入口核验返回字节、格式特征、长度及 SHA-256，已有独立文件哈希时还须匹配目标。历史调用没有这些证据，不能补认证为测过。$
patterns.replacement: ; only \1 are verified passes. Records without acceptance evidence are shown as unmeasured and excluded from pass-rate denominators and failure counts; they do not establish that the evaluated product lacks file-download support. Subsequent calls validate returned bytes, format signatures, length, and SHA-256 through the shared file path, and must match an independent target hash when available. Historical calls without this evidence cannot be retroactively certified as measured.

patterns.pattern: ^其中 ([\d,]+)/([\d,]+) 个案例还登记了任务相关的固定文字：例如 IMDb 的榜单说明、JustWatch 的观看方式说明，以及商品或餐馆的字段标签。这些文字与列表条目共同决定任务是否通过，不能只拿到三个链接就算完成。每例命中多少必需文字组，由文字核对覆盖率回答；没有文字依据的案例不计入这项均值。少量核对句不是整页参考，因此不能拿它们计算整页纯净度和 F1，否则完整返回的其它正文反而会被当成杂文扣分。$
patterns.replacement: Of these, \1/\2 tasks also register task-relevant stable text, such as IMDb ranking explanations, JustWatch viewing information, and product or restaurant field labels. This text and the records jointly determine acceptance; three links alone are insufficient. Required-text coverage reports matched groups per task, excluding tasks without textual evidence. A few check sentences are not a whole-page reference and must not be used for whole-page precision or F1, which would penalize other correctly returned text as noise.

patterns.pattern: ^延迟名言页把等待条件的问题暴露得更直接。页面可以已经完成初始请求，网络暂时空闲，正文却还要等计时器触发。本次延迟页的 ([\d,]+) 次调用中，([\d,]+) 次满足完整内容规则。浏览器启动成功或 network-idle 到达，都不能单独充当内容完成的证据。应按目标条目出现、数量与关键内容稳定来判断何时取结果；本轮没有对各种等待策略做消融，不能从一次失败计算换策略后的收益。$
patterns.replacement: The delayed-quote page exposes completion criteria directly. Its initial request may finish and the network may go idle while body text still awaits a timer. Of \1 calls, \2 satisfy the complete-content rule. Browser startup or network-idle alone is not evidence of completion. Results should be taken only after target records, counts, and key content stabilize. This run did not ablate waiting strategies, so one failure cannot estimate the benefit of another strategy.

patterns.format: {t1} passes {g2}/{g3} rendered-web tasks but has mean F1 {g4}. Among them,

patterns.pattern: ^的 F1 为 ([\d.]+%)，但没有满足该例任务规则。零通过表示没有一次满足全部任务门槛，不表示输出与参考毫无词语重合。这里的 F1 对照已保存的样本文本，只诊断文字重合，不承担实时事实核验。这份输出仍有$
patterns.replacement: has F1 \1 but does not satisfy its task rules. Zero passes means no call met every threshold, not zero textual overlap. This F1 compares saved sample text only and does not verify live facts. The output still contains

patterns.pattern: ^：完整度 ([\d.]+%)，纯净度 ([\d.]+%)，F1 ([\d.]+%)。这些指标描述输出与该例参考的重合程度。参考外文字可能是导航，也可能是有用的目录或附录，仅凭低纯净度不能认定它们全是噪声，应先核对任务的正文范围。$
patterns.replacement: : recall \1, precision \2, and F1 \3. These metrics describe overlap with the task reference. Text outside the reference may be navigation or useful contents and appendices; low precision alone does not prove it is all noise. Check the task's body scope first.

patterns.pattern: ^CSS 2\.1 标准是一个具体例子：文档目录属于本例要求保留的正文，CowAgent 这次输出相对完整范围的 F1 为 ([\d.]+%)。若参考剔除长目录，保留目录的方法会被大量扣分；这样的分差反映参考范围不一致，不能用来证明方法提取了大量噪声。$
patterns.replacement: CSS 2.1 is a concrete example: its contents belong to the required body, and CowAgent's output has F1 \1 against the complete scope. Removing a long contents section from the reference would heavily penalize methods that retain it; such a difference reflects inconsistent reference scope, not proof of noisy extraction.

patterns.pattern: ^要求书名、价格和库存核对点满足，返回长度至少为 ([\d,]+) 字符。$
patterns.replacement: requires its title, price, and stock checks and at least \1 returned characters.

patterns.pattern: ^。原文正文规则通过；替换后长度规则通过，价格核对点未通过，正文规则未通过。请求状态没有改变，但内容验收改变了。这个离线反事实只改副本，不改实测记录、不进入排名。$
patterns.replacement: . The original passes the body rule; after replacement, length still passes but the price and body checks fail. Request status is unchanged while content acceptance changes. This offline counterfactual changes only a copy, not measured records or rankings.

patterns.pattern: ^离线成功集分解，分母 ([\d,]+) 个配对网页任务；每例只进入一个分组$
patterns.replacement: Offline success-set partition over \1 paired web tasks; each task appears in exactly one group

patterns.pattern: ^(Moli|pypdf) · ([\d.]+) 秒$
patterns.replacement: \1 · \2 seconds

patterns.pattern: ^输入《Attention Is All You Need》的 PDF 地址，目标是取得论文正文。Moli 获取文件约用 ([\d.]+) 秒，本地 pypdf 提取文字约用 ([\d.]+) 秒，整条路线共 ([\d.]+) 秒，返回 ([\d,]+) 个字符。五段参考正文全部覆盖，本题词级 Precision、Recall、F1 均为 100%。$
patterns.replacement: The Attention Is All You Need PDF task requires the paper's body text. Moli retrieves the file in about \1 seconds, local pypdf extracts text in about \2 seconds, and the complete path takes \3 seconds, returning \4 characters. All five reference body regions are covered, with word-level precision, recall, and F1 each at 100%.

patterns.pattern: ^(\d+) 个案例 · (\d+) 种方法 · 六类分榜与一个综合通过率总榜。$
patterns.replacement: \1 tasks · \2 methods · six family rankings and one overall coverage ranking.

patterns.pattern: ^(\d+)/(\d+) · Codex 已核验$
patterns.replacement: \1/\2 · reviewed by Codex

patterns.pattern: ^十二种方法主矩阵的 ([\d,]+) 条机器失败结果；([\d,]+) 条机器通过结果和 ([\d,]+) 条同窗测速结果未逐条独立审查。$
patterns.replacement: Machine failures in the twelve-method primary matrix: \1. The \2 machine passes and \3 same-window latency results were not independently reviewed item by item.

patterns.pattern: ^相对 Chromium，Moli 的平均耗时减少 ([\d.]+)%，P50 减少 ([\d.]+)%，P95 减少 ([\d.]+)%。这三项在五款中均最低；跨批次条件下，尚不能确定差距有多少来自浏览器实现。$
patterns.replacement: Compared with Chromium, Moli reduces mean latency by \1%, P50 by \2%, and P95 by \3%. All three are the lowest of the five; with collection across batches, the share of the difference attributable to browser implementation remains uncertain.

patterns.pattern: ^(?:Chromium|Lightpanda|Moli(?: \d+(?:\.\d+)*)?(?: · 独立资源批次)?|Obscura)(?:、(?:Chromium|Lightpanda|Moli(?: \d+(?:\.\d+)*)?(?: · 独立资源批次)?|Obscura))+$
^独立资源 cohort：四种本地配置共同成功的 (\d+)/(\d+) 个普通网页。失败任务不进入资源汇总。$
patterns.replacement: Independent resource cohort: \1/\2 general pages passed by all four local configurations. Failed tasks are excluded from resource aggregates.

patterns.pattern: ^在四种可完整观测的本地浏览器中，(.+) 的平均 CPU 时间最低，(.+) 的平均峰值内存最低。这两个最低值可能属于不同浏览器；CPU、内存和任务通过率也不能合成一个总分。Kitesurf 在远端运行，其服务端 CPU、内存和上游流量不可见，因此不进入资源表，也不与本地浏览器容器作引擎资源排名。$
patterns.replacement: Among the four fully observable local browsers, \1 has the lowest mean CPU time and \2 the lowest mean peak memory. These minima may belong to different browsers; CPU, memory, and task pass rate must not be blended into a composite score. Kitesurf runs remotely; its server-side CPU, memory, and upstream traffic are invisible, so it is excluded from the resource table and local-browser resource ranking.

patterns.pattern: ^独立资源 cohort：五款展示配置共同成功的 (\d+)/(\d+) 个普通网页。失败任务不进入资源汇总。$
patterns.replacement: Independent resource cohort: \1/\2 general pages passed by all five displayed configurations. Failed tasks are excluded from resource aggregates.

patterns.pattern: ^在四种可完整观测的本地浏览器中，(.+) 的平均 CPU 时间最低，(.+) 的平均峰值内存最低。这两个最低值可能属于不同浏览器；CPU、内存和任务通过率也不能合成一个总分。Kitesurf 在远端运行，表中只包含本机请求客户端；其远端上游流量也不可见，不能与本地浏览器容器作引擎资源排名。$
patterns.replacement: Among the four fully observable local browsers, \1 has the lowest mean CPU time and \2 the lowest mean peak memory. These minima may belong to different browsers; CPU, memory, and task pass rate must not be blended into a composite score. Kitesurf runs remotely, so its row includes only the local request client; its remote upstream traffic is also unavailable, and it cannot enter an engine-resource ranking against local browser containers.

patterns.pattern: ^在四种可完整观测的本地浏览器中，(.+) 的平均 CPU 时间最低，(.+) 的平均峰值内存最低。这两个最低值可能属于不同浏览器；CPU、内存和任务通过率也不能合成一个总分。Kitesurf 在远端运行，表中只包含本机请求客户端；其远端上游流量也不可见，不能与本地浏览器进程树作引擎资源排名。$
patterns.replacement: Among the four fully observable local browsers, \1 has the lowest mean CPU time and \2 the lowest mean peak memory. These minima may belong to different browsers; CPU, memory, and task pass rate must not be blended into a composite score. Kitesurf runs remotely, so its row includes only the local request client; its remote upstream traffic is also unavailable, and it cannot enter an engine-resource ranking against local browser process trees.

patterns.pattern: ^本方法只使用官方 (\d+(?:\.\d+)+) 发行二进制，与其他 Moli 版本分开计分。网页正文、文档正文、结构题和网页内嵌媒体题统一使用原生 Markdown；动态网站正文整类统一启用 --layout、--with-frames 和 domstable，不按题目设置 selector。网页媒体只核对这份输出中的目标地址，不下载，也不切换 HTML、JSON 或网络跟踪接口。直接 PDF/DOCX 没有交付可读正文时按失败记录；直接媒体文件验收原始字节。评测端不使用外部 PDF/DOCX 解析器补正文，也不在失败后切换引擎或输出模式。$
patterns.replacement: This method uses only the official \1 release binary and is scored separately from other Moli versions. Webpage body text, document body text, structured tasks, and webpage media tasks use native Markdown. Every dynamic-body task enables --layout, --with-frames, and domstable, without task-specific selectors. Webpage media tasks check only target URLs in that output; they do not download media or switch to HTML, JSON, or network-tracing interfaces. Direct PDF/DOCX tasks fail without readable body text; direct media files are evaluated as original bytes. The benchmark does not supply external PDF/DOCX parsing or switch engines or output modes after a failure.

every_method_runs_the_same_150_tasks.zh: 每种方法都执行同一组 150 个任务，每题计一次通过或失败，直接相加；耗时单列展示，不参与通过率排序。总榜适合看整体交付覆盖，具体能力仍应回到六个分榜。
every_method_runs_the_same_150_tasks.en: Every method runs the same 150 tasks. Each task contributes one pass or fail and the results are summed directly; latency is shown separately and does not affect pass-rate ranking. The overall ranking shows delivery coverage, while specific capabilities belong in the six family rankings.

output_only_tables_may_come_from_page.zh: “仅输出有表格”可能来自人工主内容答案排除的页面区域，或结构被识别成表格；不是人工答案缺失。Kitesurf 的两个含表格页面调用失败，未送入评分。
output_only_tables_may_come_from_page.en: Output-only tables may come from page regions excluded from the main-content reference, or structures parsed as tables; the human reference is not missing. Two Kitesurf calls on reference-table pages failed and were excluded before scoring.

only_the_kitesurf_cloudflare_route_needs.en: Only the Kitesurf Cloudflare route needs account credentials; values are never published.

successful_fetch_time_is_the_final_succe.zh: 成功 fetch 耗时只取最终成功调用，从请求开始到转换响应结束，前次失败不相加。全部调用的累计时间另存为执行成本。浏览器批次各自串行，但不同方法可能重叠；Cloudflare 远端时间和本地 CLI 时间处于不同执行环境。是否生成正文、质量分和耗时分开报告，不能混成一个分数。
successful_fetch_time_is_the_final_succe.en: Successful-fetch time is the final successful call from request start to converted response, excluding earlier failures. Accumulated time across all calls is retained separately as execution cost. Calls are serial within a browser batch, but method batches may overlap; Cloudflare remote time and local CLI time come from different execution environments. Body-text outcome, quality and latency are reported separately, not folded into one score.

the_pinned_official_commit_is_code_9d991.zh: 使用官方提交 9d991bd 的确定性 use_llm=false 配置。代码、公式或表格在两侧都没有时，官方编辑距离返回失败，该项退出均值；只有一侧有内容时，编辑距离正常计算为 0 分并进入均值。
the_pinned_official_commit_is_code_9d991.en: The pinned official commit is 9d991bd with deterministic use_llm=false. When code, formulas or tables are absent on both sides, the official edit-distance metric returns a failed result and the component is excluded from the mean. When content exists on only one side, edit distance succeeds with a zero score and the page enters the mean.

see_the_actual_page_moli_formula_split.en: See the actual {{case_count}}-page Moli formula split

inspect_the_complete_5_versus_570_item.zh: 查看 5 对 570 个结构项的完整答案和输出

the_pinned_official_version_first_serial.zh: 官方固定版本先把“表格—行—单元格”结构写成一段括号字符串，再把字符串直接交给 APTED。APTED 在这里需要的是能逐层读取子项的树；收到字符串后，它没有读到真实的行和单元格。实测一页的输出只有 5 个结构项，人工答案有 570 个，官方记录的编辑距离却小于 1，因而给出 99.8% 的 TEDS。仅把相差的 565 个结构项补齐，代价就不可能小于 565。
the_pinned_official_version_first_serial.en: The pinned official version first serializes the table–row–cell structure into one bracketed string and then passes the string directly to APTED. APTED needs a tree whose children can be traversed; with the string it does not see the real rows and cells. In one measured page, the output has 5 structural items and the reference has 570, yet the official recorded edit distance is below 1 and the TEDS score is 99.8%. Adding the 565 missing structural items alone cannot cost less than 565 edits.

the_public_cases_use_webmainbench_545_s.en: The public {sample_size} cases use WebMainBench-545's official components; the current {current_cases} cases continue to measure live access, resources, dynamic rendering and latency. Show both without a rescaled combined score.

see_why_webmainbench_545_is_the_sole.en: See why WebMainBench-545 is the sole selection.

in_the_verified_signature_sample_the_clo.en: In the {generated_at} verified signature sample, the Cloudflare /markdown interface appears in {cloudflare_repo_count} repositories and {cloudflare_file_count} files. This signature does not identify the Kitesurf backend or user count. The other CLI/browser configurations have no matching signature inventory, so no adoption ranking is made.
